system.description: For better or worse, this incantation increases your sense of hearing for 1 minute. You passively hear events happening within 500 ft. With no sparks, any intervening material will block the magic. With one spark, you can hear a conversation through a thick wooden door. With three sparks, you can hear a rival's whisper beneath the din of a crowded tavern. With seven sparks, you can hear a snake moving through the forest in heavy rain.
